description: This PHP class 'Dependent' extends 'ListableDisplayField' and represents display logic for dependent information within the OrangeHRM reporting module. It specifies the DTO class, entity aliases, and database fields relevant to dependents in employee records.

classes.name: Dependent
classes.description: Represents a display field configuration for dependent data in reports, specifying DTO class, entity aliases, and associated database fields.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object associated with this display field.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity aliases used for query references.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of database fields related to this display field.
